syn: openssl rand [-help] [-out file] [-base64] [-hex] [-engine id] [-rand files] [-writerand file] [-provider name] [-provider-path path] [-provparam [name:]key=value] [-propquery propq] num[K|M|G|T]

o.en: Write to file instead of standard output.
Perform base64 encoding on the output.
See "Engine Options" in openssl(1). This option is deprecated.
See "Random State Options" in openssl(1) for details.
See "Provider Options" in openssl(1), provider(7), and property(7).
